fields.name: timestamp
fields.justification: Answers when the security event occurred across all disparate sources for chronological timeline reconstruction.

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: Machine identifier where the event was logged or observed
fields.justification: Allows 3x03 analysts to scope an incident to a specific host asset in the environment.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: Category identifier specifying the origin telemetry parser type
fields.justification: Enables downstream processors to parse type-specific extensions or raw formats reliably.

fields.name: event_category
fields.description: High-level category of the event such as authentication, process, file, network, or audit
fields.justification: Needed by 3x02 detection rules and 3x03 triage filters to group events independently of source vendor.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Normalized risk level or priority of the event
fields.justification: Enables automated alert prioritization and sorting during high-volume incident triage.

source_mapping.linux_text: derived from syslog level or audit success status

fields.name: user
fields.description: Account name associated with the action or event
fields.justification: Answers which user identity performed the action for insider threat and credential misuse analysis.

fields.name: process_name
fields.description: Name or executable path of the process involved in the event
fields.justification: Critical for 3x02 rules tracking execution of suspicious binaries or living-off-the-land tools.

fields.name: src_ip
fields.description: Source IP address initiating network traffic or connection
fields.justification: Answers where network traffic originated to identify external command and control or lateral movement.

fields.name: dst_ip
fields.description: Destination IP address targeted by network traffic
fields.justification: Answers where data or connections were directed to detect exfiltration or malicious target IPs.

fields.name: raw_message
fields.description: Unmodified original event text or serialized message string
fields.justification: Provides immutable evidence and context verification for forensic validation.
